name: What can I do to minimize sediment buildup in my water heater?

mainEntity.name: What can I do to minimize sediment buildup in my water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: To minimize sediment buildup, consider installing a water softener, especially in hard water areas like Las Vegas, North Las Vegas, and Henderson. Regular annual flushing is also key to preventing accumulation. If a water softener isn't an option, increasing the frequency of flushing to every 6-9 months can significantly reduce buildup and extend the life of your water heater. These proactive steps help maintain efficiency and prevent damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minimize sediment by installing a water softener in hard water areas like Las Vegas and performing regular annual or semi-annual flushing.
